name: biscuit-lane
description: A match-3 puzzle where the cats and dogs on the board are the pets you adopt, feed and raise in the room upstairs.
comment: The game itself has no dependencies and never will — every animal, biscuit and sound effect is drawn or synthesised at runtime. Playwright is here for the dev tools and the browser test layer only, and nothing it does reaches the shipped file.

scripts.sync: npm run pack && npx cap sync
scripts.android: npm run sync && npx cap open android
scripts.android:apk: npm run sync && node tools/gradle.js assembleDebug
scripts.ios: npm run sync && npx cap open ios
scripts.test: npm run test:check && npm run test:node && npm run test:browser
